# **CAREER OBJECTIVE**

Computer Engineering student specializing in Data Science, enthusiastic on software engineering and AI. Builds and deploys complete systems, from web and mobile apps to AI chatbots and vision-based AI,  learn from experienced engineers, and contribute to my team’s success.

# **DESIGN PROJECTS COMPLETED/ RESEARCHES**

**MDSystem: Medical and Dental Records System**  
Version Control, DevOps, & Frontend Head \| Apr 2026

* *A digital records system for the medical and dental clinics of TIP’s Manila and Quezon City campuses. Students fill out forms and update their records online, and clinic staff validate them, so only the required tests are left at the clinic, significantly cutting processing time compared to the previous manual process*

**MosKita: Edge AI Mosquito Breeding Site Detection**  
Researcher, Full-Stack, & ML Developer \| Apr 2026

* *An AI system that detects mosquito breeding sites from camera images in real time. It supports dengue prevention by helping locate where mosquitoes breed.*  
* *Wrote key chapters of the research paper and the guide for collecting and labeling training images, and reviewed 30+ existing patents.*

**MDS-Chatbot: AI Chatbot for MDSystem**  
Full-Stack & AI Integration Developer \| Mar 2026

* *An AI chatbot for the same MDSystem clinic platform that answers users’ questions and passes the conversation to a human staff member when needed. It runs on local infrastructure hardware, so sensitive clinic data stays in-house.*

**Pi-Monitor: Real-Time Raspberry Pi Server Monitoring Dashboard**  
Full-Stack Developer \| Mar 2026

* *A web dashboard for watching and controlling a Pi server from anywhere. It shows the server’s health in real time and can be managed remotely.*

**MARIO: AI Assistant for the Grundfos Hackathon**  
Frontend & RAG Developer \| Feb 2026

* *An AI assistant that answers questions by looking up information in a set of documents, so its answers are based on real source material.*

**GyMMS: Gym Membership Management System**  
Full-Stack Developer \| Nov 2025

* *A management system built for a gym client that handles membership renewals, QR and online payments, and member check-ins. It lets gym staff manage members and payments in one place.*

**CookEat: A Community-Driven Recipe Sharing and Culinary Heritage Preservation Web Application**  
Version Control, DevOps, & Frontend Head \| Jun 2025

* *A web application that enables users to share their own recipes, discover culinary creations from others, and connect with a community of food enthusiasts. It promotes the preservation of culinary traditions by providing a platform for documenting and sharing recipes.*

**GrowQuest: Web3 Staking Application**  
Smart Contract Developer \| Jun 2025

* *A blockchain-based application where users stake digital tokens to grow virtual plants and earn token rewards. Developed smart contracts that manage staking operations, reward distribution, and collectible plant assets on the blockchain.*
